additional_info.subject: RE: ID0459109-DC/Si-D/IT-[Multi] Unable to charge CRM:02889000812
additional_info.body:
Dear Filomena,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0459109.
Apologies for the late reply.
In regards of the session on charger
Y2/S1 313483122003
which was not initiated due to Unexpected Pilot state B from the vehicle, here are more details:
Vehicle was connected at 2025-11-01T12:10:56
Session was authenticated, parameters were exchanged between EV and EVSE, and at 2025-11-01T12:11:17 cablecheck phase started:
2025-11-01T12:11:17.223516+00:00 [FW070005G1] swcpu [user:debug] [4130] [DCC]  DC2: PilotState "B2" --> "C2"
2025-11-01T12:11:24.716156+00:00 [FW070005G1] swcpu [user:debug] [4130] [DCC]  DC2: Cablecheck: Testvoltage reached
At this point, at 2025-11-01T12:11:29 , the session is stopped from our side, due to error 67 from EcoG. As reported by my colleague before, this corresponf to "code":67,"msg":"ERR_EV_DROPPED, vehicle ended with unexpected pilot state B"
The session is stopped from our side, as we detected a wrong pilot state voltage value coming from the EV. The EV raised the voltage on the CP line, and communicated to us a PilotState B in a charging phase when a PilotState C is required. Hence the charger stopped the session.
In conclusion, the session did not initiate due to a wrong behavior of the EV.
Hope I managed to answer your doubts and provide you with more details on the failed session.
If there are no further open points from your side, I would proceed to close this ticket.
Looking forward to hearing your feedback soon!
With kind regards,
